message: A file that ships into every generated repository carries a bare LOCAL reference in its prose — a spec section or ticket prefix that means something only in the repository that wrote it. In a generated repository that identifier names a record the reader cannot reach, so the note points nowhere. Name the capability instead, or use a fully-qualified owner/repo#N. The references treated as local are the ones this deployment declares in .engine/operator-local-references.json; a repository that declares none is never flagged. This floor reads only prose — comments, docstrings, and prose fields — never a string literal, and skips test and demo files. If the flagged file does not actually ship into a generated repository, it belongs in the first-run retirement set (.engine/provisioning/first-run-assets.json).
